title: The post-quantum future of web privacy
contentSnippet: Cryptographic protocols like Privacy Pass help keep web sites safe from abuse while keeping their users private. This post looks at the quantum threat to these protocols, and some new post-quantum cryptography that may help close the gap.

title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
contentSnippet: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
contentSnippet: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

title: Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets
contentSnippet:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed threat actors using the agentic offensive security framework ARTEX to search GitHub for OAuth application secrets, which can be used to compromise the associated OAuth application and perform authenticated actions in the application’s tenant. Agents operating on behalf of threat actors then used the compromised OAuth applications to perform a variety of subsequent actions within compromised organizations.
The post Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.

contentSnippet:
